title: Laser Triangulator
subtitle: Compact optical surface measurement system
summary: A custom camera and dual-laser system for measuring printed surfaces and extrusion behaviour.

content.body: I want printer-side measurements to be based on captured geometry rather than another test line judged by eye. Fitting that measurement into a compact module makes optical alignment, rail sequencing and on-device processing parts of the same design problem.

content.title: Power sequencing
content.body: The sensor rails and I/O levels are being treated as first-class design constraints while the interface is finalised.
My current work centres on PCB layout, sensor interfacing, optical geometry and a processing path that can extract useful profiles without asking the microcontroller to become a workstation.

title: ESP32-S3 HP123 Inkjet Driver
subtitle: Parallel waveform generation for a colour cartridge
summary: An ESP32-S3 pipeline for queuing nozzle data and driving an HP123 colour cartridge through a timing-critical parallel bus.

content.body: The difficult part is not storing nozzle data; it is delivering each transition inside the cartridge's timing envelope. I am moving the output path from an earlier I²S-parallel approach to the ESP32-S3 LCD I80 peripheral so the transfer model better matches the hardware.

content.title: Current blocker
content.body: Bus allocation and transfer validation remain the immediate debugging focus.

title: ChromaSlicer
subtitle: A full-colour FDM slicing pipeline
summary: An OrcaSlicer fork exploring textured model import, colour-aware slicing and per-layer raster generation.

content.body: Colour is only useful if it survives every stage between model import and deposition. I started by giving textured geometry a UV-aware surface representation that can travel with each model volume instead of being discarded before slicing begins.

items.title: Model import
items.body: Texture-backed OBJ geometry reaches the model with UV data intact.

items.title: Raster scaffold
items.body: A per-layer colour-raster pipeline is connected to print processing.

items.title: Toolpath integration
items.body: CMYK conversion, persistence and deposition strategy remain future work.

title: Filament Scale
subtitle: NFC-aware spool tracking with a local interface
summary: A standalone ESP32-S3 spool scale combining load-cell measurement, NFC identity, storage and a responsive web UI.

content.body: I want the scale to remain useful when Spoolman or another printer service is unavailable. Weight, spool identity and transaction history therefore live locally first, with network services treated as integrations rather than dependencies.
I am shaping the interface around reliable zeroing and calibration, clear recovery from sensor failures, readable long names and a binding flow that does not assume the NFC tag is already known.

title: Gigaplex Mini Console
subtitle: A keychain game system on a 15 × 11 LED matrix
summary: A CR2032-powered miniature console with a charlieplexed display, five buttons, an IMU and a buzzer.

content.body: Gigaplex is an exercise in making severe constraints feel intentional. Every menu, animation and control has to earn its pixels, flash and battery current while the hardware still fits a keychain-sized board.
My firmware work includes recognisable low-resolution menus, multi-button input, deterministic sand simulation and compact game logic.

title: LumenPnP Upgrades
subtitle: Vision, tooling and feeder improvements
summary: A collection of practical upgrades for component placement, including vision tuning, feeder selection and nozzle tooling.

content.body: The machine is already capable of moving components; this project is about making pickup, alignment and placement repeatable enough to trust. Mechanical, optical and software changes are evaluated as one placement system.

content.title: Acceptance test
content.body: A change only counts as an improvement when it survives actual pickup, alignment and placement.

title: Voron 2.4 CAN Upgrades
subtitle: Toolhead communication and a serviceable umbilical
summary: CAN-bus debugging and wiring improvements for a Voron 2.4 toolhead and Cartographer probe.

content.body: I am making the Voron's toolhead CAN installation dependable under continuous motion. The work combines firmware and bootloader debugging with a redesign of the physical cable path after repeated conductor failures in the drag chain.
My revised umbilical approach treats conductor construction, bend radius, strain relief and support-wire behaviour as part of the communication system rather than separate mechanical details.

title: Bad Apple MCU Compression
subtitle: 2-bit video inside a tiny microcontroller budget
summary: A deterministic compression format for 15 × 11 grayscale animation targeting the CH32V006.

content.body: SBV1 is designed around the decoder that must fit on the microcontroller, not around maximum desktop compression. The format favours predictable integer-only commands and bounded memory while still leaving space for firmware and a separately arranged buzzer score.

content.title: Round-trip verified
content.body: The encoded stream was decoded and compared against the source frames before the format was accepted.

title: Firefox Video Capture Extension
subtitle: Reliable capture of browser-delivered video blobs
summary: A Firefox extension fork focused on a dependable recording pipeline, recoverable deletion and storage behaviour.

content.body: I began this extension work with an intermittent failure: a video could be detected without producing any recorded output or useful error. I compared the recording pipeline with a reliable upstream implementation and reworked it around the proven flow.
My follow-up work addresses deletion that remains stuck in a clearing state, accumulated site storage and the practical limits of long-running captures.

title: OpenPnP Vision Tools
subtitle: Package-aware detection and calibration workflows
summary: Vision-pipeline experiments for fiducials, dark component bodies, transparent tape and bottom-camera alignment.

content.body: A single threshold is rarely reliable across the packages, tape and lighting found on the machine. I use these experiments to build case-specific pipelines whose intermediate images make each decision visible.
I prioritise predictable intermediate images and parameters that remain understandable at the machine, where a false positive is more expensive than an untidy preview.

title: Custom PCB Development
subtitle: Reusable notes from compact embedded boards
summary: A developing collection of design, sourcing and assembly lessons from custom embedded hardware.

content.body: I will use this draft to collect cross-project PCB notes once the examples and photographs are ready for public presentation.

title: Charlieplexed LED Matrix Games
subtitle: Recognisable interaction at extremely low resolution
summary: A compact firmware architecture for games, menus, IMU input and sound on a 15 × 11 LED display.

content.body: I split the firmware architecture into input polling, game state, display scanning and buzzer timing so each part can remain small and predictable on the CH32V006.

content.title: Display constraint
content.body: At 15 × 11 pixels, a menu icon has to communicate before it has enough pixels to decorate itself.
Current concepts include Tetris, Snake, an IMU-driven sand simulation, dice and compact settings screens designed around the physical 2 mm LED pitch.
